maddeler.e:
ننض (form I)
# نَنِضُّ (naniḍḍu) /na.nidˤ.dˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of نَضَّ (naḍḍa)
# نُنَضُّ (nunaḍḍu) /nu.nadˤ.dˤu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of نَضَّ (naḍḍa)
# نَنِضَّ (naniḍḍa) /na.nidˤ.dˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of نَضَّ (naḍḍa)
# نُنَضَّ (nunaḍḍa) /nu.nadˤ.dˤa/: first-person plural non-past passive subjunct
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
